Title: Unsanitized User Input in RegExp Constructor (ReDoS/Arbitrary Cookie Read)
Analysis:
In `lib/helpers/cookies.js`, the `read(name)` method parses `document.cookie` using a dynamically constructed `RegExp` built from the parameter `name`. Since `name` is taken directly from the user-controlled `xsrfCookieName` configuration options without escaping or validation, an attacker could supply a malicious regex pattern in `xsrfCookieName` (e.g., `xsrfCookieName = 'a|.*'`) to bypass intended cookies restrictions or cause RegExp Denial of Service (ReDoS) / Cookie injection. Additionally, this allows reading arbitrary cookies.

Conceptual Exploit Payload:
Setting `axios.defaults.xsrfCookieName = 'SESSIONID|.*'` or a ReDoS pattern like `xsrfCookieName = '((a+)+)+'` to inject arbitrary regex syntax.
